unresolved_added: Equation 1 inserts 1.5t directly into cosine after defining the turn rate as 1.5 degrees per second. A numerical implementation must state whether the trigonometric function receives degrees or radians and apply the conversion explicitly.

Equation 7 visibly spaces the total-leg symbol as T L_i and compresses the summand around L_i, 1, 2, and 3. Preserve the printed ambiguity and reconstruct the intended finite sequence with typed indices before coding it.

Equation 9 prints the region name with a visibly spaced n-gon token while defining A_search as maximum width times maximum height. That quantity is the axis-aligned bounding rectangle, not the area of the drifting polygon, and the distinction must survive transcription.

The daily stopping rule is displayed as a sum of POD values exceeding 0.95. Daily PODs are not automatically additive probabilities; a reusable implementation needs an explicit conditional miss or survival update, dependence assumptions for repeated passes, and the day-specific moving area.

Effective sweep width is interpolated from an unfrozen external table and later altered by an unstated piecewise wind function. Target size, observer performance, sensor mode, units, interpolation domain, and calibration evidence are missing, so the resulting POD is not a field-calibrated detection probability.

The current update lacks a frozen current grid, coordinate reference system, longitude/latitude unit contract, spatial interpolation rule, boundary behavior, and time-step convergence check. The source also limits available current data to the MH370 vicinity, so neither forward nor reverse drift transfers globally.

Convex-hull closure fills nonconvex gaps in the endpoint set, and the later maximum-width by maximum-height rectangle adds further area outside that hull. Both conservative inflations must be measured separately because they directly enlarge coverage time and can dominate route comparisons.

Plane assignment is sequential and greedy: each plane takes the block of its type with most empty space, delayed aircraft lose one leg, and extra aircraft repeat earlier coverage. No joint scheduling optimality, conflict separation, overlap correlation, or independent repeated-pass detection model is established.

Figure 7 compresses more than 900 heterogeneous scenarios into an unpublished index, uses dense red/blue overplotting without a plotted legend or axis titles, and reports no uncertainty or paired scenario table. It supports a conditional within-model comparison, not a reproducible or universal route ranking.
